comment_text.value: Palisade works by utilizing dozens of specialized research backed security validators that work together to validate models across different formats (GGUF, SafeTensors, Pickle etc.,) and model families (BERT, Llama etc.,) for things like backdoor detection, supply chain vulnerabilities in the model files and model metadata. Any hidden embedded tool-calling logic can be activated by specific triggers which can be detected through a combination of static scan, schema analysis, trigger & instruction detection in models.

story_title.value: DoubleAgents: Fine-Tuning LLMs for Covert Malicious Tool Calls
